name: Corpus Knowledge Ledger
faces: Every micro-enterprise whose carriers are in the corpus, and every reader and agent who finds, links or cites them: it measures each section's knowledge debt from the corpus census, holds the integration ratchet that refuses new debt, reports each indebted section on the work board as a nonconformity of the ratchet law, and verifies repairs by measuring again. It takes no threads; the sections that own the carriers do.
